missing_charge_template.title: openWB: charge template of {entry_title} is not received
missing_charge_template.description:
No charge template has arrived on `{state_topic}` since startup. Without this topic, charge mode, limits and charging currents stay unknown and cannot be changed.

If you use an MQTT bridge to the openWB, add to its configuration:

`topic {state_topic} in`
`topic {command_topic} out`

Then restart the MQTT broker. This message disappears as soon as the charge template arrives.

details_api.description:
Enter a prefix that uniquely identifies the openWB.
*If you migrate from MQTT to the API, enter the MQTT root topic here and the integration creates the sensors etc. with the same IDs.*

Adjust the IP address and select the device type.
The device types counter, chargepoint, PV system and battery also need the device ID. You find it on the status tab of your openWB.
details_api.title: API settings for openWB

data.DEVICEID: Device ID in openWB (-> status tab)

details_mqtt.description:
Enter the MQTT root topic under which the openWB is available on your MQTT broker and select the device type.
The device types counter, chargepoint, PV system and battery also need the device ID. You find it on the status tab of your openWB.
For the device type wallbox, enter device ID 0.
details_mqtt.title: MQTT settings for openWB

chargepoint.description:
Enter the maximum charging power of your wallbox (required) and, optionally, the list of vehicles as a comma-separated list in this format:

	vehicle ID=vehicle name,vehicle ID=vehicle name

The vehicle names must match the names in openWB *exactly*; only then are the vehicles shown correctly in the vehicle selection.
You find the vehicle ID on the status tab of the openWB.
